name: implement-cmdw-tab-confirmation
task_summary: Implement Cmd+W tab close and configurable confirmation
description: Implement tab close shortcut and confirmation

spawn_spec.prompt:
Implement the Ferryx Cmd+W and tab-close confirmation feature end-to-end. You own the implementation; preserve unrelated dirty work and do not use desktop/browser automation. No destructive git commands, no commit, no Rust dependency/config/package changes. Follow existing UI DESIGN.md tokens and established patterns.

Goal A — desktop Cmd+W:
- Current root cause: native `Window > Close Window` uses a predefined menu item that captures Cmd+W before WebView. Current `File > Close Tab` has Cmd+W and emits `menu_close_tab`, but UI has no listener.
- In `src-tauri/src/lib.rs`, keep CmdOrCtrl+W for `tab.close`; replace the predefined Close Window item with an explicit `window.close` item using CmdOrCtrl+Shift+W, and route its menu event to closing the actual window.
- Add `onCloseTabMenu` to `ui/src/lib/tauri.ts` using the existing event-listener pattern, and wire it in `ui/src/App.tsx` so it invokes the active tab close intent.
- Add/extend precise tests for native bridge and App menu callback. Include a genuine RED execution before production fix.

Goal B — opt-in close confirmation:
- Add a strict persisted General settings module using existing storage key migration/hooks conventions. Name the public setting `confirmCloseTab`, default false. Add Ferryx key plus legacy Orca/Rorca aliases in storageKeys.
- Add a clear General settings checkbox: visible label "Confirm before closing a tab". It must persist and remain testable.
- Add a small accessible confirmation dialog matching existing Ferryx tokens/patterns. On enabled setting, ALL ordinary tab-close intents (Cmd+W DOM shortcut, native menu close-tab event, close X/tab-context commands routed via App's `handleCloseTab`) must show it before `closeTab` runs. Cancel must not close. Confirm must close the exact pending tab. Pinned tabs retain their existing protection.
- When disabled (default), tab closure remains immediate. Existing terminal/browser disposal behavior stays in `workspaceStore.closeTab`; do not alter it.
- Add failing-first deterministic tests covering: default setting load/save, settings checkbox persistence, native menu event bridge, native menu/App intent closes active tab, confirmation cancel/confirm, and unconfirmed immediate close. Tests must exercise actual behavior and use no sleeps.

Limit scope to required source/tests and a concise durable evidence record only if appropriate. Run targeted tests, `bun run --cwd ui build`, and the relevant cargo test(s). Return exact RED/GREEN command excerpts, changed paths, and manual desktop verification steps. Stop only with complete evidence.
